headline.zh: 上海首家开心果泡芙品牌

traits.zh: 提供开心果泡芙等法式塔类甜点，价格38–45元
traits.en: Serves pistachio éclairs and French tarts, priced ¥38–45

traits.zh: 整面临街落地窗，可见恭城路街景与窗外绿色草坪
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows with view of Gongcheng Road and green lawn outside

traits.zh: 大面积窗户采光良好，自然光充分引入店内
traits.en: Large windows provide abundant natural light

traits.zh: 2013年成立于永康路，定位‘正宗还原法式烘焙’
traits.en: Founded in 2013 on Yongkang Road, dedicated to authentic French baking

focus.zh: 采光好但无明确办公设施证据
focus.en: Good light but no evidence of work setup

linger.zh: 落地窗+草坪景观+室内绿植，适合久坐
linger.en: Street views, lawn, indoor greenery support lingering
